editorial.blurb: Viaggio brings old-school Italian cooking to Chicago's West Loop with impeccably fresh, made-to-order dishes and attentive service that makes special occasions feel truly special.
editorial.insiderTip: Request the Meatball Salad as your appetizer—it's a must-get item according to regulars—and consider the $17 valet parking option since West Loop street parking is notoriously difficult.
